title: [epic] XMPP adapter: a local XMPP server over mimid-agent's JMAP Chat (Psi, Adium, Gajim, Conversations)
description: A loopback-only XMPP server (or component): MIMI rooms as MUC (XEP-0045), 1:1 as chat, users as JIDs derived from user URIs, MAM (XEP-0313) from the agent's history, receipts/markers, HTTP upload (XEP-0363) for attachments. No OMEMO: the agent already does E2EE, the adapter link is local. All adapters sit on mimid-agent's local JMAP Chat endpoint (decision mimid-1wgh.38): the agent does MLS and holds keys; the adapter translates plaintext JMAP Chat to the client's protocol on the user's own machine, loopback only, with the agent's bearer token. Never serve plaintext beyond the local machine (AGENTS.md). Map: Chat <-> room/channel/MUC, Message <-> message, ChatContact <-> nick/JID/URI, attachments via the agent's blob routes, presence only if JMAP Chat has it. Status: idea, not scheduled.
